fullPassage: The idea that our senses may be deceiving us was taken up by the French philosopher and mathematician René Descartes. He realized that sometimes our senses give us a false impression — a straight stick in a glass of water appears to be bent, for example. And if we know that they can be unreliable, it would be wrong to trust them completely — everything that we experience with our senses might be false. It might even be that we are asleep, and that the world we are experiencing is no more than a dream, or that God or some mischievous power is making us believe things that are not really true. If that is the case, though, we can never know anything for sure. But Descartes then showed that there was one thing he could be sure of: In order to be deceived, he must exist, and exist as a thing that thinks. So, although his senses could not be trusted, he could be sure he existed as something that was capable of thinking and reasoning.

det.analysis:
✅ ④ impression(인상): 감각이 주는 거짓된 느낌/인상 — 원문의 핵심 어휘
❌ ① imagination(상상): 감각이 '주는' 것이 아닌 내적 활동
❌ ② sensation(감각): false sensation은 어색한 표현
❌ ③ perception(인식): false perception보다 false impression이 자연스러움
❌ ⑤ expression(표현): 감각이 표현을 준다는 것은 부자연스러움
det.tip: false impression = 잘못된 인상/착각 — a straight stick appears to be bent가 대표적 예시

questions.passage: The idea that our senses may be deceiving us was taken up by the French philosopher and mathematician René Descartes. ... But Descartes then showed that there was one thing he could be sure of: In order to be deceived, he must exist, and exist as a thing that thinks. So, although his senses could not be trusted, he could be sure he existed as something that was capable of __________ and reasoning.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 데카르트는 자신이 생각하고(thinking) 추론할 능력이 있는 존재라고 확신했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② thinking(생각하기): '생각하는 존재'가 데카르트 철학의 핵심 — a thing that thinks와 연결
❌ ① doubting(의심하기): 의심은 방법이지 존재의 본질이 아님
❌ ③ dreaming(꿈꾸기): 꿈은 거짓일 수 있다고 언급됨
❌ ④ imagining(상상하기): 상상은 감각에 의존
❌ ⑤ believing(믿기): 믿음은 감각에 기반할 수 있어 불확실
det.tip: thinking and reasoning = 생각하기와 추론하기 — 'cogito ergo sum'(나는 생각한다, 고로 존재한다)
